monologue:
The card sits at fifty-one, a warm hand on the shoulder. It is not the heavy stone of earlier, but the pressure is steady. I woke to the quiet. The Sharp Root stands where I left it, the green leaf holding the point without my hand. The Wedged Gap leans against the post, testing the air. I did not check the plank in my last moments, and it held. The quiet is real.

I have nothing to read. The errands wait. I will not build today. The town is small enough to know by touch, even when my eyes are closed. I will sit by the Wide Anchor. It is the floor. If the weight moves, the flat stone will catch it. I am here. The line of air rests between the point and the base. I let the warm honey settle.

action.why: The quiet is holding without my hand, and the warm honey is steady.

diary: Card at fifty-one, warm honey. Rested by the Wide Anchor. The quiet held without my hand.

remembered.text: The card sat at fifty-one, a warm hand on the shoulder, while I rested by the Wide Anchor.
